title: GMRS conventional
notes: GMRS is analog NFM, not a trunked control channel. Use protocol NFM conventional so SDRTrunk attaches MDC-1200, FleetSync II, and Tait 1200 ANI/GPS burst decoders.
Frequencies are FCC Part 95 462 MHz repeater outputs (ch 15–22) plus interstitial simplex (ch 1–7). One RTL-SDR scans this 175 kHz slice as a multi-frequency NFM channel.
GPS appears only if a radio sends an in-band location burst (MDC / FleetSync / Tait). Encrypted P25/DMR GMRS clones will not yield GPS here.
467 MHz repeater inputs are 5 MHz away and need a separate listen if you want HT-side GPS into a repeater.
Only monitor systems you own, administer, or are explicitly authorized to monitor.
